description: Benchmark corpus for council meeting minutes extraction evaluation. Keep diverse — add PDFs from different years, meeting types, and complexity levels. Do NOT add a PDF immediately after using it for prompt development without first verifying it generalises.

pdfs.label: Special Meeting (simple, no votes)
pdfs.notes: 5 procedural motions, no vote rolls published, no planning apps. Tests basic extraction without vote/planning noise.

pdfs.label: Ordinary Meeting (complex, planning + contested vote)
pdfs.notes: Planning apps, admin rec LOST 4/5 + foreshadowed CARRIED 5/4, full 9-member vote rolls, conflict of interest declarations.

pdfs.label: Special Meeting (contested vote + planning reference, complete doc)
pdfs.notes: 40k chars — fits entirely in 80k window. Underground Power and City Beach school items. Contested vote: first motion LOST 2/7, new motion CARRIED 7/1. Full 9-member vote rolls. Planning reference to DV15.152. Good test for vote scores without truncation.

pdfs.label: Special Meeting (casting vote, no planning, complete doc)
pdfs.notes: 11k chars — tiny, fits entirely in 80k window. Mayor uses casting vote to break 4/4 tie. Multiple contested motions, full vote rolls. No planning apps. Tests casting-vote edge case.
